newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trelleborg to post 1.5 bln Skr gain on Boliden.
newsitem.headline: Trelleborg to post 1.5 bln Skr gain on Boliden.

text.p: Swedish metals group Trelleborg said on Tuesday it would post a capital gain of at least 1.5 billion crowns on the sale of 51 percent of its mining unit Boliden.
"We will post a capital gain of at least 1.5 billion crowns on the sale of 51 percent of Boliden," Trelleborg chief executive Kjell Nilsson told a company seminar.
"Furthermore there will be a very comfortable capital gains taxation."
The taxation level is not final as Boliden has not yet released its latest interim report, he said.

Trelleborg unveiled plans to spin off Boliden in Canada in February. On June 11 it announced it would sell 51 million shares at C$16 each, raising C$813 million and valuing Boliden as a whole at about nine billion crowns.
Boliden will be listed in Toronto and Montreal on June 17.
